description: Add a reply to one comment thread or pin on the person's iter0 canvas, for example to answer their question or say what you changed. Free. It only appends the reply, marked as an agent's: it never resolves, reopens or deletes anything and approves nothing. operationId makes a retry safe: the same operationId and text add the reply once. Pass the thread's version from iter0_get_canvas_feedback as expectedVersion to refuse the reply if the thread changed since you read it.

designId.description: The canvas's designId from iter0_push_site, or any page's designId on it. Any other saved design the person owns also works.

feedbackId.description: A comment or pin feedbackId from iter0_get_canvas_feedback.

operationId.description: A new unique ID for this reply, reused only to retry it.

name: iter0_reply_to_feedback
title: Reply on the canvas
